scientific_limitations: Stationary one-point position distribution only: Poisson alarms, independent nonnegative multipliers in [0,1], diffusion on the whole real line without drift, and 0<E[A^2]<1.
Convex ordering applies to the latent Brownian operational time, not in general to spatial positions or pointwise tails.
Moment-generating bounds hold only on their stated common finite domain.
Classical affine-perpetuity convex-order results could imply part of the comparison; independent scientific priority assessment is outstanding.
